name: Before After Gallery by Remodelry
author: Alexandre A. Campos

sections.description:
Before After Gallery by Remodelry is a before and after gallery for WordPress. Upload a “before” and an “after” photo, and visitors drag a comparison slider to see the change. Group your photos into projects, filter the gallery by service, and add a call-to-action button to every project.

It works for anyone whose work is best shown with before and after pictures: remodelers and contractors, landscapers, painters, cleaners, detailers, salons, dentists, clinics, designers and photographers.

Nothing sells your work like the result. Each project card shows the comparison slider, the service, where the job was done and what was involved, with a button that sends visitors straight to your estimate or contact page.

Features

  • A “Projects” section in your dashboard, each with before and after photos
  • Up to 3 before/after photo pairs per project (e.g. kitchen and bathroom from the same job), each with an optional caption
  • Draggable comparison slider that works with mouse, touch and keyboard
  • Polished cards with a service tag on the photo, icons for project details and hover effects
  • One accent color setting styles the slider handle, tags, filters and buttons to match your brand
  • Optional “drag me” hint: each slider sweeps once when it scrolls into view
  • Call-to-action button on every project (e.g. “Get a free estimate”) to turn visitors into leads
  • Group projects by Service (Kitchens, Bathrooms, Basements…)
  • Gallery grid with one-click service filter buttons and project counts
  • Project details: location, scope of work, cost range and completion date
  • Every project gets its own page at /projects/project-name/ – good for local search
  • Block editor block plus shortcodes for classic editors and page builders
  • Lightweight: no jQuery on the front end, about 1.5 KB of JavaScript (gzipped); files load only on pages that show a gallery
  • Accessible: keyboard-operable slider, labeled controls, alt text fallbacks, respects reduced-motion settings
  • Translation ready

Shortcodes

Gallery of projects:

[bapg_gallery]

Options (all optional):

  • service="kitchens,bathrooms" – only these service slugs
  • columns="3" – 1 to 4
  • limit="12" – number of projects
  • filter="yes" – show service filter buttons
  • details="yes" – show location, scope, cost and date
  • excerpt="no" – show the project excerpt
  • ratio="4/3" – photo shape, e.g. 3/2, 16/9, 1/1
  • orderby="date" – date, title, menu_order, modified or rand
  • order="DESC" – ASC or DESC
  • style="card" – card or minimal (default comes from Settings)
  • compare="slider" – comparison style; the Pro add-on adds side by side, top/bottom slider, fade, tap to switch and follow the mouse

Single slider:

[bapg_slider id="123"]

Pro add-on

Remodelry Project Gallery Pro is an optional paid add-on with masonry, carousel, featured and list gallery layouts, five more comparison styles (side by side, top/bottom slider, fade, tap to switch, follow the mouse), unlimited before/after photo pairs per project (with thumbnails to step through them), and watermarks with your logo or company name. Everything in this free plugin works fully without it.
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins → Add New Plugin, search for “Before After Gallery by Remodelry” and click Install Now. (Or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.)
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Before & After → Services and add your services.
  4. Go to Before & After → Add Project, pick a before and after photo, fill in the details and publish.
  5. Go to Before & After → Settings to pick your accent color, card style and call-to-action button.
  6. Add the Before & After Gallery block (or the [bapg_gallery] shortcode) to any page.
sections.faq:
How many before and after pictures can a project have?

Up to 3 before/after pairs per project, each with its own caption. They show one under another on the project page, and galleries show the first pair. The Pro add-on allows unlimited pairs per project. A gallery can show as many projects as you like.

My photos don’t line up in the slider

Take the before and after photos from the same spot, at the same height and zoom. Both photos are cropped to the same shape, so landscape photos work best with the default 4:3 shape.

The /projects/ page shows “not found”

Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save once. This refreshes WordPress’s links.

Can I turn off the automatic slider on single project pages?

Yes. Add this to your theme’s functions.php:
add_filter( ‘bapg_auto_insert_single’, ‘__return_false’ );

What happens to my projects if I delete the plugin?

Your projects and photos stay in your database and media library. They reappear if you reinstall. Only the plugin’s settings are removed.

Does it work with my theme or page builder?

Yes. Use the block in the block editor, or the [bapg_gallery] shortcode in any theme, widget or page builder that runs shortcodes. The gallery uses your theme’s fonts and one accent color you choose in Settings.

Can visitors use the slider on phones?

Yes. Drag with a finger, click or drag with a mouse, or use the arrow keys after tabbing to the slider. Vertical scrolling still works over the photos.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The CSS and JavaScript load only on pages that show a gallery or project, images use WordPress’s responsive sizes, and there are no external requests.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • New: “Comparison style” option for the block, the shortcodes (compare="") and Settings, for add-ons that add more ways to compare photos. The drag slider stays the default.
  • For developers: bapg_compare_styles and bapg_compare_images_html filters.

1.3.0

  • New: up to 3 before/after photo pairs per project, each with an optional caption. Extra pairs show one under another on the project page.
  • Changed: the plugin is now called “Before After Gallery by Remodelry”. Projects, settings and shortcodes stay the same.

1.2.3

  • Fix: changing the accent color or other settings now shows right away on sites with a page cache (LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, SiteGround, WP Fastest Cache, Breeze).
  • Improved: the Settings page explains where projects can appear (Projects page, block, homepage sections) and lists each shortcode with a Copy button and all its options.
  • New: “Slider shortcode” column in the Projects list.

1.2.2

  • New: a “Leave a review” link on the Settings page and the Plugins screen.
  • New: a short demo video on the plugin page.

1.2.1

  • New: a link to the optional Pro add-on on the Settings page and Plugins screen (hidden once Pro is installed).

1.2.0

  • New: “Settings saved” and error messages now show on the Settings page.
  • New: hooks for add-ons: extra gallery layouts, the photo area on project pages, project photo output and the project editor.
  • Changed: the gallery block and [bapg_gallery] accept a layout option when an add-on provides more layouts.

1.1.2

  • Maintenance release. No functional changes.

1.1.1

  • Changed: Renamed the plugin to Remodelry Project Gallery.
  • Changed: Updated the plugin text domain to match its new WordPress.org slug.

1.1.0

  • New: Settings page (accent color, card or minimal style, service tag, drag hint, project link, call-to-action button, slider labels).
  • New: card design with service tag on the photo, hover lift and icons for project details.
  • New: larger slider handle in the accent color; Before/After labels fade as the handle passes.
  • New: one-time “drag me” hint animation (respects reduced-motion settings).
  • New: filter buttons show project counts; cards fade in when filtering.
  • New: responsive image sizes for faster loading on phones.
  • Changed: the bapg_details_items filter now receives key => array( 'label', 'value' ).
  • Uninstalling removes the plugin’s settings; projects and photos are kept.

1.0.0

  • First release.
